facts.fact: 本章日期为 2024 年 9 月 27 日
消失的网球以崭新荧光绿之姿回到小径旁，像刚出盒
facts.anchor: a single tennis ball left by the side of the footpath: brand new, luminous green

facts.fact: 他清楚记得自己把网球掷进了沟壑（呼应 ch04 结尾他把球掷进黑暗）
facts.anchor: He distinctly remembered throwing the tennis ball into the gully

facts.fact: 粉杜鹃墓前的石堆被翻动，周围散落新土
facts.anchor: the cairn of stones had been disturbed, and fresh earth scattered around it

facts.fact: 掘出的白瓷碎片是 ch06 夜里失踪的茶杯之一
facts.anchor: It was one of the missing teacups

facts.fact: Judge Dredd 马克杯碎成数片（ch01 他用它喝茶、ch06 它与粉 hearts 杯一起消失）
facts.anchor: found the Judge Dredd mug, broken into pieces

facts.fact: "Offerings"的声音在他脑中响起，他分不清来自内心还是电塔
facts.anchor: Offerings, said a voice in his mind – or was it from the pylon?

facts.fact: 他把银框婚礼照塞进夹克口袋，决定开始追查 Arthur 与 Caroline 的下落
facts.anchor: he slipped the photo frame into his jacket pocket
